notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (https://www.frontgate.com/robots.txt) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow and no blanket User-agent:*/Disallow:/ over category paths (only checkout/account/search/promo paths blocked) - tier (a)/(b) fully allowed. Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi, chrome impersonation) fetched robots.txt and the 4 CAT sitemaps under https://www.frontgate.com/SiteMapIndex_v2.xml cleanly (200s), but category page HTML itself is a client-rendered shell (no __NEXT_DATA__/ld+json product data, no counts) so tier (a) alone could not get qty/h1. Escalated to tier (b): headless Playwright chromium returned 'Access Denied' (bot wall) on the first category page; per rule, retried tier (b) with headed Chromium + --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled, which rendered normally (200, correct H1, product grid, 'N Items' count text) for every page attempted - used this for all data collection, no tier (c) needed. TREE: union of the 4 SiteMap_CAT_*_v2.xml files (~415 category URLs) plus each rendered category page's own canonical tag (used to detect PDP-disguised-as-category slugs and duplicate/multi-path categories). QTY: read the 'N Items' text rendered above the product grid on each category page (post domcontentloaded + wait); h1 was checked against the requested slug on every leaf. EXCLUDED: bed-bath/bath/bath-towels/{border-trim,quick-dry,egyptian-cotton,resort-towel,ladder-stitch,organic} - each canonical-redirects to a single PRODUCT DETAIL page, not a listing page (banned product-detail URL), so only the parent 'Bath Towels' (24 items) was kept; rugs-pillows/rugs/rug-pad (4 items, non-decorative anti-slip accessory, not a floor textile product); whats-new/swatches/indoor-fabric and outdoor-fabric (104/114 items, fabric sample-ordering tool for choosing furniture/drapery fabric, not a standalone home-textile product a customer furnishes their home with) and outdoor/discover/fabric-swatches + indoor-furniture/discover/fabric-swatches (both canonical-redirect to the swatches hub, not a product listing); bed-bath/bath/bathroom-accessories (26 items - genuinely mixed soap dispensers/wastebaskets/hardware/mirrors/one robe SKU, no clean per-item split, belongs to Bathroom/Decorative-Accessories tasks); rugs-pillows/pillows/ (269) and rugs-pillows/rugs/ (323) parent totals dropped per parent-URL rule since their own valid subcategories (indoor/outdoor pillows; custom/washable/wool/performance/kitchen-utility rugs, summing exactly to 323) were recorded instead; lighting-decor/home-solutions/ and indoor-furniture/bedroom-furnishings-storage/ (hub pages, no own product count, subcats recorded individually); indoor-furniture/office-furniture (19 items, Furniture not Storage); indoor-furniture/dining-furniture/bar-cabinets, tabletop-entertaining/barware-wine/bar-cabinets, tabletop-entertaining/outdoor-carts-islands, outdoor/dining/cabinets-bar-carts (bar/serving furniture, not organizational storage). DUPLICATES (same canonical reached via multiple nav paths - kept once): rugs-pillows/mats-runners and lighting-decor/home-solutions/mats-runners both canonical to outdoor/decor-accessories/door-mats; lighting-decor/indoor-decor-accessories/pillows canonical to rugs-pillows/pillows/; lighting-decor/indoor-decor-accessories/blankets-throws canonical to bed-bath/bed/blankets-and-throws; rugs-pillows/rugs/outdoor-rugs and rugs-pillows/pillows/outdoor-pillows canonical to the outdoor/decor-accessories/ versions; tabletop-entertaining/kitchen-mats-runners canonical to rugs-pillows/rugs/kitchen-utility-mats; lighting-decor/home-solutions/christmas-storage and holiday-decor/all-holiday-decor/christmas-storage both canonical to holiday-decor/christmas-storage; lighting-decor/home-solutions/pool-patio-storage canonical to outdoor/outdoor-covers-storage/pool-patio-storage. FLAGGED (LOW/MEDIUM): bed-bath/pool-beach-towels (h1 'Towels & Stands' - listing mixes fabric towels with non-textile towel stands, qty not splittable, kept as Textile MEDIUM); outdoor/umbrellas/replacement-canopies (fabric umbrella-top replacement part, analogous to the ruleset's 'Furniture Cover -> Textile' example, MEDIUM); indoor-furniture/storage-modular-furniture (h1 'Storage Cabinets & Furniture', site's own nav label is 'Storage & Modular Furniture' - mixed storage cabinets + modular furniture pieces on one listing, MEDIUM Storage); indoor-furniture/bedroom-furnishings-storage/vanity-desks-storage (h1 'Vanity Desks & Jewelry Cabinets' - vanity desks are Furniture, jewelry cabinets are Storage, one shared qty, LOW Storage, review queue).
